description: A path merely beginning with the letters 'http' is relative — there is no colon, so no scheme. But the base carries no trailing slash, so concatenating it moves the host from api.example.com to api.example.comhttpdocs, and §4's origin check refuses it.

expect.message: resolveUrlWithBase: refusing to fetch cross-origin URL (got https://api.example.comhttpdocs, expected https://api.example.com)
